# Rewordly

> Rewordly is a free Chrome extension that underlines grammar and spelling mistakes as you type on almost any website, in any language, and rewrites selected text with AI in one click. Free to start, no sign-up or API key required.

## Product

- **Name**: Rewordly
- **Category**: AI Writing Assistant / Grammar Checker / Chrome Extension
- **Platform**: Google Chrome (Chrome Web Store)
- **Price**: Free to start (no account needed to try live checking); free account with daily limits; Rewordly Pro $4.99/month or $49/year for unlimited use (fair use applies)
- **Install**: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/rewordly/bpadlnmafgmnggjjggckmoggkeimhojp
- **Website**: https://rewordly.store

## Core Features

- **Live Grammar Check (as you type)**: Clear spelling, grammar and punctuation mistakes are underlined while you write, in text boxes and rich editors on most websites. Hover an underline to see the suggestion and a short reason, then apply, ignore, or add the word to your dictionary. "Fix all" applies every suggestion in a field.
- **Automatic Language Detection**: Each sentence is checked in its own language (for example English, Turkish, German, Spanish), with no settings to change. Explanations are shown in the language you wrote in.
- **Fixes Keep Formatting and Undo**: Corrections go through the site's own editor, so formatting stays intact and undo works.
- **AI Text Rewriting**: Select text and click Rewrite to improve clarity and fluency while keeping the meaning. Pro returns up to three alternatives.
- **Tone Control**: Standard, Formal, Casual, Concise, or Elaborate.
- **Shorter / Longer**: Tighten or expand a rewrite without retyping.
- **Apply In Place**: Put the rewritten or corrected text straight back into the field.
- **Context Menu and Shortcuts**: Right-click → Rewordly → Rewrite or Check Grammar; Ctrl+Shift+E to rewrite, Ctrl+Shift+L to check grammar (configurable).
- **Control**: Turn live checking off in the popup, or disable Rewordly on any site.

## Where It Works

Text boxes and editors on most websites in Chrome, including Reddit, X (Twitter), Medium and LinkedIn. Password fields, fields marked as email, phone or payment details, and code editors are skipped. Google Docs is not supported yet.

## Privacy

Only the field you are typing in is checked, sentence by sentence; only changed sentences are sent again. Check results (flagged words and suggestions, not the full text) are kept to make repeated checks faster. Text is processed with OpenAI's API. Rewordly does not sell user text. Full policy: https://rewordly.store/privacy

## How It Works

1. Install the extension and write anywhere. Mistakes are underlined after you finish a sentence or pause.
2. Hover an underline and click the suggestion to fix it.
3. To rewrite, select text (3+ characters), click Rewrite, adjust tone or length, then Apply or Copy.

## Use Cases

- **Non-native English speakers**: catch mistakes before sending emails, posts and comments.
- **People who write in several languages**: one tool that follows you from one language to the next.
- **Professionals**: clear, correct emails and messages without leaving the browser.
- **Creators and community members**: polished posts and replies on Reddit, X, Medium and LinkedIn.
- **Students**: see what's wrong and why, not just a corrected copy.
